caption: The drawing depicts a square cloth or handkerchief with a decorative floral pattern. The cloth has a border consisting of two stripes: the outer stripe is green with a dotted pattern, and the inner stripe is red with a small white geometric pattern. Inside the bordered area, the main field of the cloth features a repeating pattern of stems with green leaves and red flowers, which have yellow highlights and are dotted with white. The background of the cloth is filled with closely spaced gray lines forming herringbone or leaf-like shapes, giving texture to the negative space. The overall color scheme includes off-white, green, red, yellow, and gray tones. The drawing has a clean and orderly composition with all elements neatly contained within the square shape of the cloth.
title: Applique Quilt
